document: US Patent 7129094 B1, chemical agent simulant training composition (2006)
agent: liquid G-agent simulants including VX, and H-agent (mustard-HD) simulants
measurement: granted claim 1(a) requires a vapour-generating component with a vapour pressure of about 0.1 to about 30 mm Hg at 25 C, present in an amount sufficient to be detectable by a vapour detection apparatus; claim 3 lists 23 admissible components; claims 4-6 prefer DPGME, methyl salicylate or their mixture; specification names ion mobility spectrometers (CAM), infrared and surface acoustic wave detectors
stated_basis: the patent constrains volatility by a numerical window and requires that a detector respond. It asserts that the vapour characteristics are comparable to G and H agents but presents no measurement of an agent beside the simulant, and it rests the choice of DPGME and methyl salicylate on their having been used as simulants for years.
